name: Fireflies.ai
description_en:
Fireflies.ai helps teams retain and revisit information from online meetings. The directory describes recording across web-conferencing platforms, transcription of live meetings and uploaded audio, and playback alongside the transcript. Team members can comment on specific passages and search for action items or other discussed topics. Calendar-based joining and distribution of recording links are also described. Its reported CRM connections make meeting logs and notes available within existing customer workflows. The practical focus is on turning spoken conversations into searchable team records; recording consent, connector permissions and the limits of a chosen plan still need an official check.

Fireflies.ai is a product in the AI meeting assistants category. Its directory profile covers Meeting Recording, Meeting Transcription, Meeting Search, CRM Integration.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $10.00. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: save supported meeting audio or video for later reference. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Fireflies.ai 帮助团队保存和回看在线会议中的信息。第三方介绍涉及跨会议平台录音、实时会议及上传音频的文字转写，以及对照文字回放音频。成员可以在具体片段上批注，并搜索行动项或讨论主题。资料还介绍了通过日历加入会议、分发录音链接，以及将会议记录和笔记连接到 CRM 的方式。其主要用途是将口头沟通转为可检索的团队记录；录音授权、连接器权限和具体方案限制仍需核对官网。

Fireflies.ai 属于AI 会议辅助软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括会议录制、会议转写、会议内容搜索、CRM 集成。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $10.00. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：保存受支持的会议音视频以便后续查阅。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
